title: Community models can stay private
summary:
Private community models, a 1080p Veo option, 3D monitoring, and URLs you can actually share.

Owners can register and call private community models, which appear in model catalogs only when using their API key. New models default to Private; existing models remain Public. Eligible publishers can make models Public, while dashboard and Polli CLI controls handle visibility and pricing. My Models now explains each owner's publishing options, and the API docs describe how private models appear in authenticated model lists.

Google Veo 3.1 Fast now has fixed-resolution choices: `veo` generates 720p video, while the new `veo-1080p` generates 1080p. Width and height still set the aspect ratio, not the resolution tier. Model descriptions and API docs now spell out the distinction.

The community-added Model Monitor category tracks 3D models alongside other model types. A new guide shows how to request a GLB from an image URL, and the API reference now includes `GET /3d/models`. Trellis 2 uses the image, not a text prompt—an easy detail to miss.

highlights.title: Private community models
highlights.text: Register and call a community model without listing it for everyone. New models default to Private, and visibility can be managed in the dashboard or Polli CLI. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Veo at 1080p
highlights.text: Choose `veo-1080p` for 1080p Veo 3.1 Fast video, or `veo` for 720p. Width and height set the aspect ratio; the model sets the resolution. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=veo-1080p).

highlights.title: Monitor 3D models
highlights.text: Check 3D generation models in the Model Monitor alongside the existing model categories. [Open the Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Dashboard links worth sharing
highlights.text: Enter pages now have direct URLs, and links can retain model searches, activity filters, and Pollen view settings. [Explore models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
